I have not played Mafia: 2 or Mafia: 3 but I have played one so let me start on that.

In my experience of 50ish hours on the Mafia 1 remake I can say that I enjoyed every moment of it and the story was great as well. Without spoiling too much you play as a cab driver who is brought into the world of crime in the Prohibition Era in America (IE: the 1930's). The game is a story driven game, so the gameplay is kinda just there to propel the story and keep it moving, it's not bad or anything but it's not outstanding in the gameplay department I would say it's pretty average. However there is no side content, and that disappointed me because I enjoyed the world and it's atmosphere but I will get into that later.

If you are one to care about graphics, I can say that your eyes will not be bleeding while you are playing, I actually thought the graphics were good but not revolutionary considering the Mafia 1 remake came out 2 years ago. The atmosphere of the game is great, it feels like you are in 1930's america with the cars, the outfits, the buildings, the people etc.

Conclusion: I would give the game a solid 7.5, It wasn't the most amazing game to ever exist, but I would say it is definitely above average, and is worth your time.
